subject: Pen test scope addendum & evidence checklist for SIG/CAIQ
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <security@titanhealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: GRC Portal <grc-portal@titanhealth-gov.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: penetration test report for SIG + CAIQ artifact

Hi Maya,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/CAIQ submission we need the full penetration test report (redacted as appropriate) and a short scope addendum describing the in-scope assets and timing of the engagement. The GRC portal requires the artifact and a mapping to the CAIQ controls; see ticket 1723: https://grc.titanhealth.com/tickets/1723.

Specific asks:
- Latest PT report (redacted PDF acceptable)
- A one-page "scope addendum" that lists the systems in-scope (hostnames, cloud accounts, on-prem segments) and dates of testing
- Current remediation tracker (which findings are fixed / in progress / planned)

We need to upload to the portal by EOD Friday (2027-07-02) to keep our SOC 2 submission on schedule. Please let me know the expected delivery and whether you prefer portal upload or a secure transfer link.

Thanks,
Alyssa Greene
Security Program Manager
Titan Health
security@titanhealth.com

[Attachment: GRC_ticket_1723_summary.txt (text/plain)]

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Greene <security@titanhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report for SIG + CAIQ artifact

Hi Alyssa — appreciate the heads up and the portal link. Short answer: yes, we can provide what you requested.

Summary of what we'll deliver by the portal (or secure link if you prefer):
- redwood_pt_summary_v1.pdf (sanitized executive report; includes scope addendum page)
- redwood_pt_raw_findings_redacted_v1.pdf (technical report with PII/critical infra redacted)
- remediation_status_tracker.xlsx (current status: fixed / mitigated / in progress / planned)
- pt_redaction_guidelines.docx (notes on what was removed and redaction rationale)

Delivery plan and timeline:
- Today: share the summary PDF and remediation tracker as a draft (this email thread)
- By 2027-07-07: security team produces a sanitized raw report suitable for vendor portals (we'll aim earlier if possible)

A few clarifying points about scope (so we're aligned with your CAIQ mapping):
- In-scope: customer-facing inference endpoints, control-plane dashboards, test accounts in the us-west-2 and eu-west-1 clusters, and the administrative console.
- Out-of-scope: internal CI/CD runners, developer local machines, and third-party vendor networks (we can provide a separate list of vendor contacts if you need those tests).
- Testing window: 2027-05-12 to 2027-05-16 (this will go in the scope addendum page).

Attachment stubs included with this message: redwood_pt_summary_v1.pdf (application/pdf) and remediation_status_tracker.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet).

We are cc'ing Karthik (Security Engineering) and Vanessa (GRC operations) to coordinate the redaction and upload. If you prefer the GRC portal upload, please confirm access; otherwise we can provide a time-limited S3 transfer link.

Best,

Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: redwood_pt_summary_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: remediation_status_tracker.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report for SIG + CAIQ artifact

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 11:03 AM Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> A few clarifying points about scope (so we're aligned with your CAIQ mapping):
> - In-scope: customer-facing inference endpoints, control-plane dashboards, test accounts in the us-west-2 and eu-west-1 clusters, and the administrative console.
> - Out-of-scope: internal CI/CD runners, developer local machines, and third-party vendor networks
> - Testing window: 2027-05-12 to 2027-05-16

Thanks Maya — quick update from SecEng side: we'll produce a sanitized raw report and a short scope addendum page. Redaction/PII review path below.

Redaction & delivery plan (security engineering):
- Today: review the raw PT export and mark items requiring redaction (credentials, internal IP internalization, certain hostnames)
- 2027-07-05: deliver first redacted draft to GRC ops (Vanessa) and Solutions (Maya) for review
- 2027-07-07 EOD: final sanitized PDF ready for upload to external portals

Remediation snapshot (high level):
- Total findings: 24
- Fixed: 14 (including auth bypass POC mitigation, config drift fixes)
- In progress: 6 (WAF tuning, session timeout fixes)
- Planned: 4 (scheduled across July/August)

We will attach a cleaned remediation_status_tracker.xlsx version that maps each finding to CAIQ control IDs for your upload. Vanessa, I'll hand the draft to you when the first redacted report is ready.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

[Attachment: pt_redaction_guidelines.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Maya / team — thanks for the clear plan.

Portal preference: please upload the final sanitized PDF(s) and the remediation tracker to ticket 1723 (https://grc.titanhealth.com/tickets/1723). The portal will ask for a CAIQ mapping spreadsheet; the tracker with a CAIQ column will work.

Given our internal approvals, we need the upload completed by EOD today (2027-07-02). If you hit any blocker on redaction timeline, send the summary PDF + remediation tracker to the secure S3 link below and we'll reciprocally accept that for today's cutoff.

Secure transfer: https://s3.redwood-secure-transfers.com/one-time/abcd-2027 (expires 2027-07-03T00:00:00Z)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll follow up with the audit team if we need any additional attestations.

Best,
Alyssa
